# ona_organization_policies (Resource)

Manages selected organization policies for the organization associated with the authenticated provider token. Omitted attributes remain unmanaged. Destroying the resource restores the original values of attributes changed through this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ona_organization_policies" "current" {
  maximum_environment_timeout           = "8h"
  maximum_running_environments_per_user = 4
  maximum_environments_per_user         = 10
  port_sharing_disabled                 = false

  members_require_projects = true
  members_create_projects  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_local_runners` (Boolean) Whether local runners are allowed. The Ona API currently rejects enabling local runners through organization policies. Omit to leave unmanaged.
- `maximum_environment_timeout` (String) Maximum timeout allowed for environments as a Go duration, such as `30m`, `2h`, or `0s`. Zero means no limit; non-zero values must be at least 30 minutes. Omit to leave unmanaged.
- `maximum_environments_per_user` (Number) Maximum total environments per user. Omit to leave unmanaged.
- `maximum_running_environments_per_user` (Number) Maximum simultaneously running environments per user. Omit to leave unmanaged.
- `members_create_projects` (Boolean) Whether organization members can create projects. Configure together with `members_require_projects`; their values must be opposite.
- `members_require_projects` (Boolean) Whether non-admin users can only create environments from projects. Configure together with `members_create_projects`; their values must be opposite.
- `port_sharing_disabled` (Boolean) Whether user-initiated port sharing is disabled. System ports remain exempt. Omit to leave unmanaged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Authenticated organization ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ona_organization_policies.current current
```
